key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll monthly billing and weekly SuperGrok credits

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show the Grok logo in the top panel

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Grok logo variant: light (for dark panels), dark (for light panels), or color

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP proxy URL (e.g., http://localhost:11809). Leave empty to use no proxy.

key.name: show-monthly-panel-bar
key.description: Whether to show the monthly progress bar in the top panel, independent of its percentage text

key.name: show-monthly-panel-text
key.description: Whether to show the monthly percentage text in the top panel, independent of its bar

key.name: show-weekly-panel-bar
key.description: When weekly data exists (auto poll), show its progress bar in the top panel, independent of its percentage text

key.name: show-weekly-panel-text
key.description: When weekly data exists (auto poll), show its percentage text in the top panel, independent of its bar

key.name: show-panel-bar
key.description: Whether to show the progress bar column on every metric row in the top panel

key.name: show-panel-percent
key.description: Whether to show the percentage-text column on every metric row in the top panel

key.name: show-monthly
key.description: Whether the monthly metric row appears in the top panel at all

key.name: show-weekly
key.description: Whether the weekly metric row appears in the top panel once auto-polled weekly data exists

key.name: stack-panel-bars
key.description: Whether to stack the monthly and weekly panel bars vertically instead of side by side

key.name: show-bar-labels
key.description: Show a single-letter metric tag (M = monthly, W = weekly) to the left of each panel bar so the two are distinguishable at a glance

key.name: warn-on-projected-depletion
key.description: Project current burn rate (from usage history) forward; if a limit is on track to hit 100% before its reset time, blink the affected panel bar orange/red or blue/red. Alpha feature — default off.

key.name: last-fetch-succeeded
key.description: Whether the most recent billing poll returned 200

key.name: refresh-trigger
key.description: Incremented by prefs.js after the manual token-refresh subprocess completes. The running extension watches this key and immediately re-fetches usage instead of waiting for the next poll interval.

key.name: flash-on-refresh
key.description: Brief flash when a live monthly poll succeeds

key.name: csv-export-dir
key.description: Directory the user last saved a usage-history CSV export to, remembered across sessions so the save dialog reopens there
